findings.key_quote: Three Months Ended June 30, 2025 2026 YouTube ads 9,796 11,055
findings.justification: E4 provides the exact figures for YouTube ads revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2025 ($9,796 million) and June 30, 2026 ($11,055 million). The growth is (11,055 - 9,796) / 9,796 = 12.9%, which is more than 10%. Period_status is UNKNOWN but the passage explicitly states 'Three Months Ended June 30' for both years, matching the claim period exactly.

findings.key_quote: YouTube ads revenues increased $1.3 billion and $2.2 billion from the three and six months ended June 30, 2025 to the three and six months ended June 30, 2026
findings.justification: E1 states that YouTube ads revenues increased $1.3 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to the three months ended June 30, 2025. From E4, we know the base was $9,796 million, so $1.3 billion / $9.796 billion = 13.3% growth, which exceeds 10%. The passage explicitly references 'three months ended June 30' for both periods.
